# Zstandard 1.5.7

Upstream: https://github.com/facebook/zstd/tree/v1.5.7

Used under the BSD license in `LICENSE`. `zstd.h`, `zstd_errors.h` and `LICENSE` are unchanged upstream files.
`zstd.c` is generated by the upstream single-file library tool, without local modifications.
The engine compiles it through `Funke-Engine/src/Assets/Zstd.cpp`.

Source archive: https://codeload.github.com/facebook/zstd/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.5.7

SHA-256: `37d7284556b20954e56e1ca85b80226768902e2edabd3b649e9e72c0c9012ee3`

To regenerate from that release, run in `build/single_file_libs`:

```sh
python combine.py -r ../../lib -x legacy/zstd_legacy.h -o zstd.c zstd-in.c
```

Copy the resulting `zstd.c`, `lib/zstd.h`, `lib/zstd_errors.h` and the upstream `LICENSE` into this directory.
